newsitem.title: UK: Euro raw cotton mart sees interest in Central Asia.
newsitem.headline: Euro raw cotton mart sees interest in Central Asia.

text.p: Central Asian styles stayed at the centre of buying interest in a European market where some traders saw a fair demand from spinners in Western Europe needing cotton for shipment in July/October.

But many customary traders in these styles were reluctant to make substantial additions to existing commitments and potential buyers were obliged to look for an alternative, with West African and Syrian mentioned.

Turkey saw a revival in offtake for US cottons following a Washington announcement last week of an additional line of credit. The business concluded has involved both lower qualities and selected better grades.
